resources.string: Open Context & history in the chat menu to save or share the full conversation as Markdown or original OpenCode JSON. Follow the server wait and per-stage progress, with percentages where measurable. A valid cache avoids downloading the same chat again. JSON can include private context omitted from Markdown.
A Markdown export shows the server wait, download and preparation progress. The next export switches to JSON and skips downloading by reusing the cache.
File ready to save or share
Same chat: reuse the cached JSON
